capabilities: Find semantically similar notes in a live side panel, ranked by similarity score
Embed notes with a built-in offline model, Ollama, or an existing index file
Batch-populate a related: frontmatter field across the vault or the current note
Suggest [[links]] while typing when text matches an existing note title or alias
Visualize similar notes in a native-style graph view with drag-to-link nodes
extras: Free with optional Ko-fi tips; desktop only (Windows, macOS, Linux) and requires Obsidian 1.7.2 or later; built-in model (~25 MB) downloads on first index from Hugging Face and jsDelivr, then runs offline.
intentEvidence: It was intended to replace Local Graph View by showing more info and expanding linking functionality.
motivation: The author built the graph view to offer more information and linking functionality than Obsidian's native local graph.
problem: Obsidian's graph view only reflects manually created links, so notes that are related in meaning but never linked stay disconnected as a vault grows.

relations.evidence: connect any locally-running Ollama embedding model for full control and more powerful models
point it at a custom frontmatter date field combined with Linter plugin

summary: Semantic similarity plugin that finds related notes with embeddings and shows them in a side panel, with batch linking via a related frontmatter field.
